# RTSTM 2026: radiative transfer school in Hendaye

The **International CNRS Thematic School on Radiative Transfer in
Semi-Transparent Media** takes place on **3–9 October 2026** in Hendaye,
just across the Bidasoa from the Basque Country. It is organised by the French
research federation [TAMARYS](/network/networks/tamarys.html).

Over a week, about 65 doctoral students, researchers and engineers will cover:

- **Lectures** on the basics of thermal radiation, solving the RTE, gas
  radiation and its approximate models, scattering in particulate media,
  radiation physics of solids, near-field transfer, and identifying the
  radiative properties of semi-transparent media.
- **Practical sessions** on advanced Monte Carlo methods, IR thermography and
  spectroscopy, and modelling of gas radiative properties.
- **Evening seminars** with ArianeGroup (atmospheric re-entry) and Saint-Gobain
  (high-temperature furnaces).

Registration closed on 30 June.

The school opens a new listing on this site:
[**Schools & courses**](/events-news/schools.html), a record of training in
thermal radiation and emissivity, kept next to the conference calendar.
